mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which can lead to reduced economic activity and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when housing starts decline by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when industrial production increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening demand side of the economy, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when real personal consumption expenditures increase by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with high borrowing costs, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the federal funds rate is above 2% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) remains stable (less than 0.2% change), it signals strong labor demand without significant inflationary pressure, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and CPIAUCSL changes < 0.2%
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the consumer price index remains stable.
